title: Yellow Energizing Filipino Freekeh Halo Halo
description: A refreshing and energizing Filipino dessert featuring freekeh, with a floral and glassy-jelly texture, perfect for hot summer days. This dish is a unique twist on the traditional halo halo.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, bring the water to a boil over high heat.
Add the freekeh to the boiling water, reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes or until the freekeh is tender.
In a large bowl, whisk together the pandan extract, yellow food coloring, and sugar until well combined.
Add the cooked freekeh to the bowl and stir until the freekeh is evenly coated with the pandan mixture.
In a separate bowl, mix together the coconut milk, kaong, nata de coco, and jackfruit.
To assemble the halo halo, place a scoop of the freekeh mixture in a glass, followed by a spoonful of the coconut milk mixture.
Top with crushed ice and serve immediately.
Repeat the layers one more time, ending with a layer of crushed ice on top.
Serve the Yellow Energizing Filipino Freekeh Halo Halo chilled and enjoy.
